observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black AOC monitor with a dark screen. The AOC logo is visible at the bottom center of the bezel. The monitor is placed on a dark surface, possibly a sofa, with a tufted black leather background. A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI TEKMANN' is overlaid.
Photo 1: Slightly angled front view of the same monitor. The top right corner of the bezel shows '27P1' printed. The screen is off. Same watermark and background.

Photo 2: Rear view of the monitor. The AOC logo is visible on the back. The stand is attached, and there is a VESA mount bracket. On the left side, ports are visible: one HDMI, one DisplayPort, and two USB ports (one blue, one black). The stand base shows some scratches. Background includes a black tufted sofa and a white marble-patterned surface with some clutter. Watermark present.

claims.evidence: Model 'Q27P1' is visible on the top right bezel in photo 1. Brand 'AOC' is visible on the front bezel (photo 0) and back (photo 2).
Scratches are visible on the stand base in photo 2. No visible damage to screen or bezel, but no close-up of screen for dead pixels or burn-in. No proof of internal condition or functionality.
This is a subjective claim about use case. The monitor's features (QHD, IPS) support office use, but cannot be proven from photos alone.

risks.risk: Screen damage or defects (dead pixels, burn-in, cracks)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the screen with a white background or pattern test, showing full screen area.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially defective, which reduces value

risks.risk: Monitor does not power on or has connectivity issues
risks.proof: Video clip showing the monitor turning on, displaying a test pattern or connected to a device.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which reduces value significantly

risks.risk: Ports or USB hub not functional
risks.proof: Video clip showing a device connected to HDMI/DisplayPort and USB ports, with successful output and data transfer.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the screen with a white background to check for dead pixels or defects.
Video clip showing the monitor powering on and displaying an image from a connected device.
Video clip showing a device connected to the HDMI/DisplayPort and USB ports, with successful output and data transfer.
response.reason: The model and brand are confirmed, but critical risks like screen condition and functionality are unproven. Without proof of working condition and screen integrity, the item cannot be priced accurately. The photos show minor scratches on the stand, but no evidence of screen or internal issues.
